card.name: The word Day in schedules and named days
card.fires_on: The capitalized word "Day" when it follows a dose or schedule term and is followed by a number, or when it ends the name of an observance or event.

modes.label: Dosing schedule day
modes.description: "Day" starts a numbered day label in a dosing or treatment schedule.

modes.label: Named observance or event
modes.description: "Day" ends the name of a holiday, awareness day or event.
